name: Error-Derived Verification Rules
hypothesis: Explicit symbolic verification rules mined from historical failure modes reduce systematic polarity inversions and abstention bias without fine-tuning or few-shot exemplar overhead.

data_partitioning.isolation_policy: Strict zero-leakage: Dev/Test claims are never used in pattern mining, rule synthesis, or prompt calibration.

arms.name: Zero-Shot Base Control
arms.description: Frozen Qwen3-8B BF16 direct verification without injected rules.

arms.name: Generic Rules Control
arms.description: Standard high-level fact-checking best practices (Corroboration, Contradiction, Sufficiency).

arms.name: Length-Matched Generic Control
arms.description: Elaborated methodological guidelines matching E1 token count (+/- 15%) to isolate length and structural complexity effects.

arms.name: Error-Derived Rules
arms.description: Rules mined from historical Train Fold-1 failure patterns targeting Temporal Mismatch, Partial Support, Direct Negation, and Numerical Precision.

arms.name: Shuffled / Irrelevant Rules Control
arms.description: Matched-length negative control containing linguistic/stylistic rules irrelevant to factual correctness.

invariant_assertions: Identical evidence rendering across all 5 arms per claim
Zero Dev gold label exposure in rule sets
